snippet.title: NORSE Oath of Blood - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
A new gameplay trailer for NORSE: Oath of Blood, captured completely in-engine using a mixture of live gameplay and in-game cinematics. The game is coming to PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S late 2025, and can be wishlisted now on Steam. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #norseoathofblood

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
